query:
INSERT INTO budget (id, daily_budget, loads_today, day, last_ramp_at)
             VALUES (1, ?1, ?2, ?3, ?4)
             ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
                 daily_budget = excluded.daily_budget,
                 loads_today = excluded.loads_today,
                 day = excluded.day,
                 last_ramp_at = excluded.last_ramp_at
